CustomField.description: Status with an emoji for list views. Shows legal hold first, then limit closes.
CustomField.formula: IF(IsOnLegalHold__c, "🔒 Legal hold", IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Active"), "🟢 Active", IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Archived"), "📦 Archived", IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(ConversationCloseReason__c, "Message Limit Reached"), ISPICKVAL(ConversationCloseReason__c, "Token Limit Reached")), "🟡 Hit limit", "⚪ Closed"))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Active, closed at a limit, closed, archived or on legal hold.
CustomField.label: Status Display
